component.name: OpenJournal
component.summary: Local-first ink notebook for pen and paper replacement

description.p: OpenJournal is a local-first notebook for handwriting, drawing and note taking. Your notes live in ordinary files on your own machine — no account, no cloud, no telemetry — so the same notebook opens on Windows and Linux.

ul.li: Pressure-sensitive pen with ballpoint, fountain and brush nib styles
Translucent highlighter, eraser, and scribble-to-delete gesture
Smoothed ink with ruled pages and a margin line
Continuous vertical page scroll with automatic new pages
Image insertion, selection, move and delete; drag and drop supported
Zoom, hideable distraction-free interface, light and dark themes
Read-only import of Microsoft Journal .ink files
